hook: Accessibility trees nearly quadrupled GPT-4.1's computer-use score
hookText: How should AI see a screen?

beats.say: Greptile tested how computer-use agents should see the screen, across seven OpenAI models and 172 OSWorld tasks.
Weaker models gained a lot from the accessibility tree. GPT-4.1 rose from 5.4 percent to 20.6, and GPT-5.2 from 15.8 to 36.2. Clicking by element ID pushed GPT-5.2 to 52.8 percent.
The strongest barely moved. GPT-6.1 Sol scored 83.8 percent with screenshots alone and 82.7 with the tree added, and none of the three strongest models changed significantly.
